Skills.Name: Rites
Skills.Description: Initiation into the consuming rites. Every rite spends a charge of grimoire ink per cast and consumes status marks (Burning, Wet, Electrified, Frozen...) off its targets — cast cold it is deliberately weak; fed a primed target it is not. Rites are learned from grimoires found in the world, or bought here.

Powers.Name: Rite of the Storm Anvil
Powers.Description: Bring the storm down on everything within radius 2: 4 electric damage scaled by consumed marks, and each mark's rider lands — Stun, Arc, or Shatter. Cooldown 25. Requires grimoire ink.

Powers.Name: Rite of the Hanging Bolt
Powers.Description: Pin one creature (range 6) under a suspended bolt: 2 flat electric damage, and 2 turns of paralysis per mark consumed. Cooldown 30. Requires grimoire ink.

Powers.Name: Rite of Rendered Steam
Powers.Description: Render the soaked-and-burning to scalding steam within radius 2: 5 fire damage, +150% and Confusion against anything carrying both Wet and Burning. Cooldown 35. Requires grimoire ink.

Powers.Name: Rite of the Scalding Veil
Powers.Description: Boil the water off your own skin into an 8-turn veil that scalds and confuses attackers. Refuses (free) unless you are Wet. Cooldown 30. Requires grimoire ink.

Powers.Name: Fulmination
Powers.Description: Crack a bolt into one creature (range 5) and write charge into the ground beneath it, where it goes looking for somewhere to run. Cooldown 25. Requires grimoire ink.

Powers.Name: Rite of the Shattered Rime
Powers.Description: A cone of brittle cold (range 3): 6 damage scaled by consumed marks, and marked survivors lose armor to shatter. Cooldown 40. Requires grimoire ink.

Powers.Name: Rite of the Still Heart
Powers.Description: Still one heart (range 5): 2 cold damage, and 8 turns of unwakeable sleep per mark consumed. Cooldown 45. Requires grimoire ink.

Powers.Name: Rite of the Verdigris Bloom
Powers.Description: An acid bloom across radius 2: 5 acid damage scaled by consumed marks; marked survivors take Shatter Armor and Acidic. Cooldown 40. Requires grimoire ink.

Powers.Name: Rite of the Hollow Coin
Powers.Description: Call in every debt at once (range 4, spends up to 3 marks of any element): 3 damage scaled by marks; 3+ marks break the debtor outright. Cooldown 50. Requires grimoire ink.

Powers.Name: Rite of the Sundering Word
Powers.Description: Speak the sundering word over radius 2 (any element): 4 damage scaled by marks; the marked are left Broken and Weakened. Cooldown 45. Requires grimoire ink.

Powers.Name: Rite of the Bloodletter's Ledger
Powers.Description: Write one creature into the ledger (range 5, any element): 4 damage scaled by marks, Bleeding that deepens with marks — and 4 HP healed to you per mark, paid even over a corpse. Cooldown 40. Requires grimoire ink.
